subject: [PATCH] nfsd: switch nfsd4_open() to use vfs_lookup_open()

reviews.author: NeilBrown
reviews.summary:
NeilBrown pointed out that lookup_open() does not require I_MUTEX_PARENT because the opened inode will not be locked, and suggested that using the same subclass for all cases was a simpler approach

reviewer pointed out a lockdep issue that needs to be addressed, referencing a link to the specific patchset on sashiko.dev
reviews.raw_body:
This is of no consequence.
start_creating() doesn't really need I_MUTEX_PARENT as the child will
never be locked.  Only start_removing() and start_renamed() need that.
But it was simpler to use the same subclass for all cases.

lookup_open() could use I_MUTEX_PARENT but doesn't need to as the opened
inode will not be locked, whether it is created or not.

---

Thanks,
NeilBrown

2026-09-03.patch_summary: This patch updates the nfsd4_open() function in the NFS daemon to use vfs_lookup_open(), which simplifies the code and reduces complexity.
